summary_markdown: Finance approvers face consistent timeout failures during month-end close when filtering large datasets. The issue has persisted for 4 months, impacts 12 approvers, delays reimbursements, and causes SLA misses. Current CSV split/re-upload workaround is costly and unreliable.

feedback.what_help_is_needed: Fix approval-page timeout and support performant filtering + bulk approval for large close-cycle volumes.
feedback.customer_scenario_and_desired_outcome: During month-end close, approvers review 400+ items and filter by cost center. Current page times out at ~45 seconds. Desired outcome is sub-5-second filtering and reliable bulk approval for 500 items to complete close on schedule.
feedback.customer_impact: Issue recurs each close cycle over 4 months, affects 12 approvers, causes 1-2 day SLA delays, and delayed reimbursements for ~180 employees last month.
feedback.workaround_details: Team exports CSV, splits by region, and re-uploads smaller batches. Two analysts spend ~6 additional hours each close, and large regions still fail.

priority.rationale: Recurring close-cycle failure with measurable operational and employee payout impact; workaround is expensive and unreliable.

evidence.quote: The approval page times out after around 45 seconds when filtering by cost center.
Every close cycle, for the last 4 months. We have 12 approvers across regions.
We miss our internal SLA by 1-2 days and delay payouts. Last month this blocked about 180 employees.
We export CSV, split by region, and re-upload... two analysts about 6 extra hours.

open_questions: Is timeout behavior tied to specific browser/session settings?
What is the acceptable reliability target (e.g., p95 latency/error rate)?
